title.narrative: Medical and nutritional assistance targeting the most vulnerable people affected by the conflict in the Menaka region of northern Mali

description.narrative: Awarding agency: U.S. Agency for international development cfda listing / assistance listing: 98. 001 USAID foreign assistance for programs overseas cfda narrative excerpt: the purpose of USAIDs bureau for humanitarian assistance (BHA) international disaster assistance (IDA) program is to provide life-saving humanitarian assistanceincluding food, water, shelter, emergency healthcare, and other critical aid to the worlds most vulnerable and hardest-to-reach population affected by natural, man-made and complex disaster. Bha is the lead federal coordinator for international disaster assistance, harnessing the expertise and unique capacities of other U.S. Government, non-U.S. Entities & public international organizations (PIOS) to effectively respond to natural disasters, complex crises by providing emergency and food assistance around the world. Recipient: doctors of the world usa, inc. (DOTW) this award will provide financial support to doctors of the world usa, inc. For a program entitled, medical and nutritional assistance targeting the most vulnerable people affected by the conflict in the menaka region of northern Mali in Mali. The goal is with the aim of contributing to the reduction of morbidity and mortality among the most vulnerable and hard-to-reach beneficiaries in the mnaka region, our central objective remains to significantly improve access to quality holistic healthcare and nutrition services. The theory of change underlying this mission suggests improving the availability and capacity of primary and secondary healthcare services, including nutrition services, while integrating community health and nutrition awareness activities. The total number of beneficiaries that will be supported under this award is 64,600 individuals.
